g.text: • Lawson Tutorial Warning [Law18]: Admixture proportions describe genetic contributions relative to sampled clusters,

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #d55e00

g.text: NOT a person's literal family tree, recent genealogies, or historical migrations. Admixture coefficients do not equal pedigrees.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #d55e00

g.text: Foundational Forensic Evidentiary Principle of Biogeographical Ancestry [Job22, Tve22]

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: • BGA inference provides an investigative intelligence lead to narrow follow-up, conditional on the reference populations tested.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: • It does NOT establish personal identity, ethnicity, race, social identity, birthplace, culture, or individualize a suspect.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: • Investigative leads must be corroborated through independent autosomal STR profiling before any operational action.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #8c8c8c
